meta.artifact: Workspace functionality inventory — every tool, flow and state needed to rebuild the UI
meta.positioning: Quil is frontend UI/UX design software for technical developers — NOT a website builder. Core theory: 'Zero Design Drift'. AI only proposes; nothing becomes design truth until the user approves it, and every approval is a scoped, undoable decision.
meta.intended_use: Hand this file to a frontend designer as the single source of truth for rebuilding the workspace UI. Pair it with the visual reference (quil-workspace-mockup.html) and the rationale doc (quil-redesign-spec.md).
companion_files: quil-workspace-mockup.html — pixel reference of the rebuilt shell (porcelain #f5f0f0 on espresso #15100d theme)
quil-redesign-spec.md — full rationale, ASCII wireframes, implementation slices S1–S8

terminology.Screen: A top-level artboard. UI label is always 'Screen' even though internal schema keys still say 'page' (pageId, add_section). Designers must never surface the words 'page' or 'section' in UI copy.
terminology.Frame: A layout container on a screen (internally 'section'). Figma users think in frames.
terminology.Element: A leaf node: heading, text, button, card, image, navigation, form.
terminology.Decision: An approved design choice recorded in the decision registry, with a scope (Instance / Screen / Global) and provenance. Decisions supersede, they are never deleted.
terminology.Candidate: An AI-proposed variant awaiting approval. Lives in a preview layer, never in the committed document.
terminology.Spec / Blueprint: The structured per-screen generation contract (frame list + requirements) that drives layered generation. Rendered in product language, never raw JSON.

meta.layout_philosophy: Three columns with a hard rule: AI on the LEFT, canvas manipulation on the RIGHT, canvas CENTRED. One line to remember: left decides, right refines, centre shows.

global_rules.detail: AI output is never applied directly. Candidates preview on a separate layer; only Approve (through the scope picker) turns a candidate into decisions via the apply_candidate command. Reject/Regenerate are always available.
Every edit gesture (drag, resize, type, colour) produces exactly one command on release. Esc / blur / pointercancel aborts with zero state change. Everything is undoable.
All AI payloads are validated with strict Zod schemas at the boundary. The model never writes to the document or spec directly — only through approved diff cards / candidates.
Each tool is reachable via at most three of: canvas, panel/toolbar, keyboard/palette. Do not add a fourth entry point.
Every status (save state, key state, coverage, badges) combines icon + text/tooltip so it works without colour.
Every entry point has a keyboard equivalent; full map in keyboard_shortcuts. Focus is never trapped; Esc always backs out one level.
All chrome colours/sizes come from the design token set (see design_tokens_reference). Canvas owns the colour; accent is reserved for decisions, approval and selection.
Elements stack in document flow. No absolute positioning, no freeform x/y, no rotation. 'Reorder' and 'padding' are the only layout tools.
Prompt: 256 chars. Variants per generation: 1–6 (default 3). Screens per project: 50 (bounds.maxPages). Spec frames per screen: 20. Spec elements per frame: 20.
Variant preview swap < 50ms. Respect prefers-reduced-motion: no zoom/scroll animations; variant swap is a hard cut.
Candidates record the document revision they were generated from (baseRev). Applying a stale candidate is rejected (STALE_BASE) and the card offers Rebase (if properties are disjoint) or Regenerate.

regions.name: Top bar
regions.geometry: Full width, 48px tall, spans all columns
regions.rules: Undo/redo live here (global convention). Top bar is never selection-dependent — identical whether an element is selected or not.

regions.name: AI rail (left)
contains: Intake launcher (footer, when no spec exists)
regions.rules: AI-related content ONLY. The prompt box is the product's primary input and must never scroll out of view.

Scrollable canvas with one screen (artboard) at a time
Floating bottom-centre tool strip: Select · Frame · Text · Insert · Hand
Keyboard hint pill (top right): / insert · C colour · G prompt
regions.rules: Screen tabs belong to the canvas column, not to either rail. Approved frames render normally; pending frames render as dashed placeholders with an inline ghost Generate button.

responsive_behaviour.1100–1279px: Rails narrow to 280px; design tree collapsed to a header bar by default.
responsive_behaviour.<1100px: Rails become toggle-over drawers (tree/inspector from right, AI from left). Workspace stays desktop-first; Landing/Settings pages remain responsive to 360px.

tools.name: Prompt box (with target chip + variants stepper)
tools.zone: AI rail — pinned top of Generate tab
tools.what_it_does: The primary AI input. Captures a natural-language design request, shows exactly what it will affect, lets the user choose how many variants to generate, and submits the request.
tools.how_it_works: Always visible at the top of the Generate tab. Above the textarea a target chip shows the current target — 'Screen: Dashboard', 'Frame: Hero', or 'Selection: Button' — with a dropdown to retarget. The textarea has a 256-char cap with counter. Below it sit a quantity stepper ([−] count [+], range 1–6, default 3) and a full-width Generate button. Enter submits; Shift+Enter inserts a newline. Submission goes through the request layer (idempotency keys, retries with backoff); successful candidates land in the variant tray and the queue updates.

entry_points: Pinned and visible whenever the Generate tab is active
Generate context action on a pending frame's ghost button (pre-fills the box)
keyboard: G focuses the prompt box from anywhere

states.ui: Generate disabled/spinner state; queue card shows the running frame
Generate disabled with inline reason + Settings link; manual design tools unaffected
error surfaced on the queue/candidate card with Retry; prompt box stays usable

commands_fired: AI request via request layer (no document command until a candidate is approved)

tools.name: Variant tray (candidate cards)
tools.what_it_does: Shows the N candidate variants for the current target as cards with live miniatures, and is where approval happens: preview, approve (with scope), reject, regenerate.
tools.how_it_works: Cards render under the prompt after generation. The active card previews on the canvas through the overlay layer (<50ms swap, never touches the committed document). Clicking a card previews it. Approve opens the scope row inline (A3) and on confirm fires apply_candidate, which converts the candidate into one or more decisions. Reject discards. Regenerate re-runs for that frame. Card header shows variant number; the active one carries a PREVIEW pill. Candidates record baseRev; stale ones surface Rebase/Regenerate instead of Approve.

keyboard: 1–9 selects the active variant (when tray is open)

states.ui: accent ring + PREVIEW pill; canvas shows the variant
standard card with Preview + Regenerate actions
Stale label; [Rebase] if disjoint properties, else [Regenerate]; Approve hidden
card resolves; frame status → approved; decisions appear in Decisions tab

tools.name: Scope picker
tools.zone: AI rail (inside approve flow) + compact row in inspector
tools.what_it_does: Chooses the decision scope an approval applies at — Instance / Screen / Global — and shows in plain language what will change plus a live count of affected elements ('affects 9').
tools.how_it_works: Moved into the approve flow inside the variant card (scope is part of making a decision), with a compact permanent row in the inspector for re-scoping an existing decision later. Three segmented options; selecting one recomputes the affected count from the decision registry. The effect text is plain language, e.g. 'Screen · affects 9'.

entry_points: Inline in the variant card after clicking Approve
Inspector scope row for the selected element
keyboard: S focuses the scope row for the current selection

change applies across the current screen
change applies everywhere the property is not already overridden; count usually highest

commands_fired: scope is a parameter of apply_candidate / set_property

tools.name: Spec blueprint (Spec tab)
tools.what_it_does: Makes the per-screen generation contract readable and editable: one plain-language row per frame requirement, with live status, inline editing, and AI-proposed changes as approve/reject diff cards.
tools.how_it_works: Header: 'SPEC · Screen: Dashboard' + coverage total ('3/5 frames') + screen switcher. Rows are auto-summarised from the structured spec (kind + counts + key props) — never raw JSON. Row click scrolls the canvas to that frame (or its dashed placeholder if pending). [Edit spec] swaps rows to inline editors: text field per row, kind picker, reorder handles, delete, [+ Add frame] with the 7-kind picker. Every edit dispatches update_page_spec (Zod-strict, bounds: 20 frames/screen, 20 elements/frame) so spec edits are undoable and persisted. Editing the spec of an APPROVED frame flags it 'spec changed — regenerate?' — the old frame stays until the user approves a replacement; never silent mutation. When intake/generation proposes spec edits they arrive as diff cards ('+ Table frame: 10 rows, sort by MRR' / '− Footer frame'); Approve applies via update_page_spec, Reject discards.

entry_points: Spec tab in the AI rail
keyboard: Row navigation via Tab; Enter opens the row's frame on canvas

states.trigger: spec edited under an approved frame
states.ui: flag chip 'spec changed — regenerate?'; canvas frame gets dashed accent outline + chip

tools.name: Decisions list (Decisions tab)
tools.what_it_does: Browsable registry of every approved decision: what property, what value, at what scope, when, and what it supersedes. Clicking one highlights everything it affects on canvas.
tools.how_it_works: Rows grouped by screen/kind. Each row: colour/property swatch, property name (e.g. button.bgColor), value + provenance ('Brand rose · approved 2 min ago', 'contrast AAA'), scope chip (Global/Screen/Instance). Superseded decisions remain in history (marked, ordered below the live one). Filter box narrows by property/value. Click → highlight affected elements on canvas.

entry_points: Decisions tab in the AI rail
Decision badges (◆) in the design tree link to the relevant entry

states.trigger: the screen it applied to was deleted

states.ui: affected canvas elements highlighted until Esc/click-away

tools.name: Generation queue (progress card)
tools.zone: AI rail — Generate tab, between prompt and candidates
tools.what_it_does: Persistent, visible progress for layer-by-layer generation: which screen, how many frames done ('3/5'), which frame is generating, what is pending. Doubles as the control surface for the loop.
tools.how_it_works: Derives from the screen spec. Rows: ✔ done / ◌ generating / ○ todo, plus a progress bar. Interjection is allowed anytime: clicking a pending frame on canvas or in the tree prioritises it next; selecting an element switches the prompt target chip to it. A failed frame never blocks the queue: its card shows Retry, and the queue pauses after 2 automatic retries with jittered backoff. Manual editing is never blocked.

entry_points: Per-frame Generate (ghost button on placeholder, queue row, or prompt box)
keyboard: No dedicated key; reachable via palette

states.ui: rows + progress bar; current frame accent
paused state on failed frame + Retry button; other frames unaffected
summary; coverage dot on the screen tab fills

commands_fired: drives per-frame generation; approvals flow through apply_candidate

tools.name: Intake launcher
tools.zone: AI rail footer + canvas empty state
tools.what_it_does: Entry point into the guided intake wizard whenever the project has no spec yet.
tools.how_it_works: Appears as 'Run guided intake' in the AI rail footer when no spec exists, and in the blank-project canvas empty state ('Design your first screen' + [Insert (/)] + [Run guided intake]). Routes to /new?project=:id — the wizard is bound to an existing project and can never be reached without one.

tools.name: BYOK status chip
tools.what_it_does: Shows the AI key state at a glance and links to Settings. Guarantees the user always knows whether AI features are live, offline, or failing.
tools.how_it_works: Top bar chip and an inline status line in the AI rail footer ('BYOK active · gpt-4o-mini · Manage'). Text + icon + colour, never colour alone. Click opens Settings (flow F4).

tools.name: Select
tools.what_it_does: Picks an element, frame or screen for inspection and editing. Selection drives the inspector, the prompt target chip, and canvas outlines.
tools.how_it_works: Click an element on the canvas (data-element-id) to select; hover shows a light outline; the selection gets accent outline + corner handles. Tab / Shift+Tab cycle through elements; Esc deselects. Selecting on canvas highlights and scrolls the corresponding tree row into view, and vice versa. Focus returns to the canvas container after tree selection so V→Tab flows keep working.

states.ui: inspector shows screen-level properties + spec coverage
outline + handles; inspector shows element groups; prompt target chip = Selection

commands_fired: none (selection is view state, not document state)

tools.name: Design tree
tools.what_it_does: The full Screen ▸ Frame ▸ Element hierarchy in one navigable tree: select, rename, reorder, insert into, duplicate, delete — with decision/drift/pending badges.
tools.how_it_works: Sits at the top of the right rail (≈40% height), collapsible to a 40px 'Design tree ▾' header. Rows: kind icon + label; labels derive from content (text prop) or kind+index; indentation guides; collapse chevrons (collapsing a screen hides its frames). Filter box narrows by substring while preserving hierarchy. Two-way selection sync with canvas. Drag rows to reorder within a parent or move across frames (same screen in MVP) with drop indicators; Alt+↑/↓ moves the row. Hover reveals row actions (⋯ → Duplicate / Delete / Insert into frame). '+' on a screen row inserts a frame (spec-aware defaults); '+' on a frame row inserts an element (kind picker). Double-click renames — this is element META (display label), not document text.

states.ui: accent-soft row highlight, synced both ways

states.trigger: element deviates from its approved decision

commands_fired: set_element_meta (rename — or namespaced set_property, decided at build)

tools.name: Edit text (in-place)
tools.what_it_does: Inline editing of any text content: headings, labels, button text. Plain text only — no rich formatting.
tools.how_it_works: Double-click a text-bearing element (or Enter/T on a selection) to place a caret. Enter commits; Esc cancels with zero change. Commit produces one coalesced set_property on the text property.

tools.name: Insert menu
tools.what_it_does: Adds a new element or frame with schema-valid defaults. Seven element kinds; images stay disabled until an assets story exists.
tools.how_it_works: '/' opens the insert menu overlay near the selection/insertion point. Canvas ghost '+' buttons and tree row '+' open the same picker (spec-aware defaults for frames). Choosing a kind inserts with sensible defaults immediately editable. Invalid contexts (image without assets) render disabled with a tooltip.

tools.name: Reorder
tools.what_it_does: Changes the order of elements/frames within the flow layout — the ONLY layout rearrangement tool (no free positioning).
tools.how_it_works: Drag rows in the tree (drop indicators show the target gap); Alt+↑/↓ nudges the selected row. Moves can cross frames within the same screen (MVP). The canvas reflects flow order; nothing is ever absolutely positioned. Abort (Esc/pointercancel) leaves zero change.

tools.name: Resize
tools.what_it_does: Adjusts kind-dependent REAL properties via handles — image width/height, card padding/radius, button radius, text size — never a transform.
tools.how_it_works: Selection renders a per-kind handle table (corner handles for radius, edge handles for padding, 8 handles for image w/h). Dragging previews live via requestAnimationFrame; on release exactly one coalesced set_property is committed. Arrow keys nudge 1px; Shift+Arrows 10px. Esc aborts with zero change.

states.ui: rAF live preview of the real property

tools.name: Type properties
tools.what_it_does: Font size, weight, line-height, alignment and family (from a fixed allowlist) for text-bearing elements.
tools.how_it_works: Inspector group appears for kinds that support type. Numeric fields validate inline — invalid values show a message and change nothing. Weight is a segmented control (400/600/700/800). Cmd/Ctrl+B toggles bold.

entry_points: Inspector Type group on supported selection

tools.name: Colour picker
tools.zone: Design rail — inspector Colour group + overlay picker
tools.what_it_does: Sets background/text colours. Approved colours are offered FIRST (consistency by default), and a live WCAG contrast badge updates as you choose.
tools.how_it_works: Inspector swatch row shows: the approved decision swatch (✓ mark), alternative swatches, and a custom '+' slot. Clicking a swatch or the custom slot opens the colour picker overlay. Contrast badge beside the row shows the live ratio of the chosen colour against its background (e.g. 'AAA 16.7:1'). Picking a colour that matches an approved decision reuses that decision rather than duplicating it.

keyboard: C opens the colour group/picker for the selection

states.ui: AA/AAA ratio, pass styling, always text+value

tools.name: Space & shape
tools.what_it_does: Padding, corner radius and shadow (three fixed levels, no free-form effect stacks).
tools.how_it_works: Inspector group per supported kind. '[' and ']' cycle shadow level down/up. Some kinds expose the same values via canvas handles (see M6). Invalid values are rejected inline, changing nothing.

tools.name: Duplicate / Delete
tools.what_it_does: Copies an element/subtree in place, or removes it — always undoable.
tools.how_it_works: Duplicate performs a single batch command (subtree in one step). Delete removes the element; deleting a SCREEN asks for confirmation and orphans its decisions (registry rule: marked, not destroyed). Project deletion (Projects page) is type-to-confirm.

tools.name: Zoom / Pan / Hand / Fit
tools.what_it_does: View-only navigation: zoom, pan, hand tool, fit-to-screen. Never mutates the document.
tools.how_it_works: Zoom row (− / percentage / +) plus a Fit button that scales the artboard to the viewport. Per-screen zoom & scroll are remembered for the session and restored on tab switch (session state, not document state). Hand tool and Space-drag pan the canvas.

tools.name: Undo / Redo
tools.what_it_does: Reverts/reapplies history one gesture at a time — including approvals and spec edits (undoing an approval removes its decisions and updates scope counts).
tools.how_it_works: Built on Immer inverse patches; every command is one undo step. Top bar buttons mirror the keyboard.

tools.name: Screen manager (multi-screen)
tools.what_it_does: Creates, switches, renames, duplicates, reorders and deletes screens; shows per-screen generation coverage.
tools.how_it_works: Tabs across the top of the canvas column, each with a coverage dot (filled = all frames approved; half = in progress; empty = untouched). '+' adds a screen. Beyond 6 tabs an overflow '»' dropdown lists screens with dots + search. Right-click context menu per tab: Rename · Duplicate (frames + elements in one batch) · Reorder left/right · Delete (confirm; decisions on that screen become orphaned). Reordering (tab drag or context menu) dispatches the reorder_pages command. Exactly ONE screen is visible at a time — a gallery view is explicitly out of scope. Cmd/Ctrl+P opens the quick screen switcher (palette in screen mode).

keyboard: Cmd/Ctrl+P quick switcher (type to fuzzy-find a screen)

tools.name: Command palette
tools.what_it_does: Search-anything: every action, screen, frame and setting is one keystroke away. Also serves as the quick screen switcher.
tools.how_it_works: Cmd/Ctrl+K opens an input with subsequence (fuzzy) matching over the command registry, including 'go to screen/frame' entries. Cmd/Ctrl+P opens the same palette pre-seeded in screen mode. Enter executes; Esc closes.

tools.name: Zen mode
tools.what_it_does: Collapses both rails for a full-bleed canvas review of generated screens.
tools.how_it_works: Toggled with Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+\. Both rails hide; the canvas owns the window. Any rail action, the same hotkey, or Esc restores the layout.

tools.name: Project name (inline edit)
tools.what_it_does: Displays and renames the current project without leaving the workspace.
tools.how_it_works: Name shown with a small ✎ affordance; click to edit inline; commit = one command; Esc cancels.

tools.name: Save status indicator
tools.what_it_does: Communicates persistence health (write-behind to IndexedDB/Dexie).
tools.how_it_works: Derived chip: 'Saved' after flush, 'Saving…' during write-behind, 'Error' on failure — at which point the recovery screen is offered, the queue pauses writes, and the canvas keeps working in memory. Icon + text, never colour alone.

tools.name: Preview
tools.what_it_does: Opens the view-only preview of the designed screens — how the product actually renders, with real flow layout.
tools.how_it_works: Launches the preview overlay from the current screen; navigation between screens allowed; no editing. Esc or close returns to the workspace.

tools.name: Settings
tools.what_it_does: Houses BYOK provider config (flow F4), storage options, and account (auth) entries.
tools.how_it_works: Routes to /settings. See flow F4 for the BYOK panel spec.

overlays.name: Colour picker overlay
overlays.notes: Approved colours listed first; live contrast badge inside.

overlays.name: Context menus (canvas + tree)
overlays.notes: Duplicate / Delete / Insert into frame; screen tabs have their own menu.

overlays.name: Read-only banner (multi-tab follower)
overlays.opens_via: automatic when a second tab holds the write lock

flows.name: Project creation (always BEFORE intake)
flows.hard_rule: A project record exists before the wizard can open. The wizard is bound to a projectId and never standalone. Route /new requires ?project= — guard it.

steps.name: Projects page
steps.ui: Grid of project cards: name (inline rename), screens count, spec-coverage % ring, last edited. Card menu: Rename · Duplicate (snapshot copy) · Export JSON · Delete (type-to-confirm, wipes local keys). Sorted recent-first; no folders in MVP.

steps.name: New-project modal
steps.ui: Title 'New project' + ✕. Field 'Project name' (autofocused, prefilled 'Untitled project', text selected on focus). Section 'Start with' — two selectable CARDS (not a dropdown): 'Blank canvas — empty screen, build with /' and 'Guided intake — AI asks, you approve steps'. Footer [Cancel] [Create project].
steps.activation: Enter submits; Esc/✕ cancels with nothing persisted

steps.name: Create
steps.ui: No spinner purgatory: optimistic navigation while the snapshot writes (sub-ms locally).

steps.name: Route
steps.ui: Blank choice → /p/:id with empty-state nudges. Guided choice → /new?project=:id (intake wizard).

flows.name: Intake wizard (grouped 4-step, Enter-to-submit everywhere)
flows.hard_rule: Full-screen route /new?project=:id bound to the existing project. Esc = save & exit to workspace (progress persists per project and reopens at the last completed step). Back/Next always available. Skippable steps are labelled 'Optional' and record defaults. Focus moves to the first field of each step (WCAG 2.2 AA).

steps.name: Brief
steps.ui: Autofocused textarea ('What are you designing?') with counter (e.g. 182/5000). Hint line under the field: 'Enter to continue · Shift+Enter for newline'. Example chips ([SaaS dashboard] [Fitness app] [Crypto wallet] [Admin console]) FILL the field, never auto-submit. No AI key → inline chip 'Working offline — suggestions will be generic' + Settings link; mock provider keeps the flow functional.

steps.name: Screens
steps.ui: AI proposes a screen list from the brief (strict Zod schemas). Editable card list: name · type chip (Dashboard / Detail / List / Auth / Settings / Custom) · one-line 'will include' summary (AI-drafted, editable inline) · drag or Alt+↑/↓ reorder · remove · [+ Add screen]. Minimum one screen; maximum bounds.maxPages (50).

steps.name: Style direction (Optional)
steps.ui: Three direction cards (swatch strip + font pair + radius/density preview), single-select — this is a DECISION, not a mood board. Under the selected card: accent colour override (picker with live contrast badge vs bg), font pair from the allowlist, density (comfortable / compact). 'Use Quil defaults' skip link. On approval each choice becomes a GLOBAL decision through the normal command bus.

steps.name: Review & generate
steps.ui: Summary: brief excerpt, screen list with frame counts, style card thumbnail, BYOK status. Primary [Generate screens] closes the wizard → workspace with the generation queue running and the AI rail on the Generate tab. Secondary [Save and exit] stores the spec and defers generation.

flows.name: Layer-by-layer generation (the core loop)
flows.hard_rule: One layer at a time, each approved before the next — this is what makes Quil design software rather than a slot machine. Generation is driven by the spec; coverage is the progress metric.
flows.layer_model: Screen ▸ Frame ▸ Element. Pass 1 — skeleton: generate/review the frame list per screen (names, order, kinds), approved as one batch. Pass 2 — frame content: N variants per frame, preview on canvas, approve with scope → decisions. Frame status: pending → generating → needs approval → approved. Pass 3 — refinement: select any element, prompt retargets to 'Selection: X', N variants for that element only, same approval loop.
flows.canvas_behaviour: Pending frames render as dashed placeholders with the frame name + inline ghost [✦ Generate] button (AI-on-canvas). Approving fills the placeholder in place. Approved-but-spec-changed frames get a dashed accent outline + 'spec changed' chip opening the diff card.
loop_mechanics: Interject anytime: click a pending frame (canvas or tree) to prioritise it next; select an element to retarget the prompt.
Stale-base discipline: candidates carry baseRev; stale apply → STALE_BASE rejection; card offers [Rebase] (disjoint properties) or [Regenerate].
Failure isolation: one frame failing never blocks the queue — card Retry; queue pauses after 2 auto-retries (jittered backoff); manual editing never blocked.
Idempotency: CandidateId dedupe — double-approve is a no-op.
Coverage: screen-tab dot (filled/half/empty); Spec tab shows '3/5 frames · 12/28 elements resolved from decisions'. All derived from state, never stored twice.

flows.name: BYOK settings (bring your own key)
flows.hard_rule: Session-only storage is the DEFAULT and the recommendation. The key lives in memory for the tab session (destroyed on unload/logout), never in IndexedDB, never in logs/analytics/URLs (logger redaction).

steps.name: Test key
steps.ui: [Test key] runs one minimal, abortable call (timeout + AbortController). Result shows provider + model ('✓ Valid · gpt-4o-mini reachable'), NEVER the key.

steps.name: Model
steps.ui: Dropdown sourced from src/config/models.json per provider; wrong-model errors surface as recoverable ProviderError.

steps.name: Storage
steps.ui: Radio: ◉ This session only (recommended) / ○ Remember on this device — the latter is phase-2 and renders DISABLED with a tooltip until an encrypt-at-rest design ships.

steps.name: Save / Clear
steps.ui: [Save] persists the choice; [Clear key] wipes it. Footnote: 'Keys are redacted in logs and never sent anywhere except the provider you chose.'

element_kind_controls.note: Only schema-supported properties per kind. Selection toolbar shows the top 3 for the kind; the inspector shows the full group. Insert menu offers 7 kinds; frames (sections) take padding/colour.

tree_badges.◆: element carries an approved decision (tooltip: which)
tree_badges.⚠: drift detected on an element inside

edge_cases.behaviour: Canvas empty state: 'Design your first screen' + [Insert (/)] + [Run guided intake]; AI rail footer shows the intake launcher.
Prompt box still works for manual design; Generate disabled with reason + Settings link; intake runs on the mock provider with clearly-labelled generic suggestions.
Failed frame card shows Retry; queue pauses after 2 auto-retries; manual editing is never blocked.
Card marked Stale + [Rebase] if properties are disjoint, otherwise [Regenerate].
Read-only banner; rails render but all mutation entry points are disabled with tooltips.
Save status → error + recovery screen; queue pauses writes; canvas keeps working in memory.
Removes the decision(s) via inverse patches; scope rows and affected-counts update accordingly.

edge_cases.situation: Spec edit under an approved frame
edge_cases.behaviour: Flagged 'spec changed — regenerate?' + diff flow; the frame is never silently mutated.
Tab overflow dropdown (with search); the design tree always shows all screens.
No zoom/scroll animations; variant swap is a hard cut.

out_of_scope.note: Deliberate exclusions — the designer must NOT add these to the workspace (they break the product thesis or are scheduled post-MVP):
exclusions: Freeform x/y position and rotation (flow layout + reorder + padding only)
Hand-authored constraints / responsive rules (auto flow; preview is view-only)
Gradients / blend modes / effect stacks (flat fills; 3 shadow levels)
Component authoring (decision sharing is communicated by the decisions list + tree badges)
Variables / token editor (approved decisions ARE the tokens)
Custom fonts, image editing / crop (font allowlist; image fit modes)
Comments / multiplayer / plugins / code export (revisit later)
Gallery view of all screens at once (one screen at a time + tabs covers it)

design_tokens_reference.note: Chrome is built exclusively from these tokens (matching quil-workspace-mockup.html, porcelain-on-espresso theme). Accent is reserved for decisions/approval/selection — never decoration.
